automated.note: entities come from a fixed feature-term lexicon matched in code, so unsupported additions are impossible by construction; checked anyway

quote_support_sample.method: seeded sample (sha256 'quote-audit:' + review_id) of 20 long reviews (>280 chars) where the quote is one selected sentence; short reviews use the full text as the quote

finding: Quote selection picks the sentence with the most topic keywords; when the specific problem is stated in a later sentence (case 5) or the label is itself debatable (cases 4, 15, 16), the quote can be weaker evidence than the full review.
